name: Flare stack / boom system with knockout drum, seal drum, flare tips, pilots and ignition
description: Safely disposes of relieved and waste gas from PSVs and shutdowns. Header routes gas to a KO (vapour-liquid separator) drum, then a water/liquid seal drum preventing flashback, then an elevated stack or ground flare with pilots and continuous ignition. Stack height or boom reach is set by permissible thermal radiation.

specifications.basis: Recommended maximum for continuous exposure of personnel wearing appropriate industrial clothing; 500 Btu/hr.ft2
4.73 kW/m2 (1500 Btu/hr.ft2) limits exposure to 3-4 minutes
6.31 kW/m2 (2000 Btu/hr.ft2) limits exposure to 30 seconds

specifications.metric: Sonic flare tip upstream pressure threshold
specifications.basis: Wikipedia gas-flare tip configurations: 'sonic tip - upstream pressure >5 bar'
Flare specification for enclosed flares: >1000 and <1200 degC to ensure 98% destruction efficiency and avoid NOx formation; 0.3 s residence time in chimney

specifications.metric: Flare destruction efficiency (LRGO multi-point ground flare)
specifications.basis: John Zink LRGO: 'highest destruction efficiency (typically >99.5%) of any flare type'; API 537 compliance available
